items.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
items.description_zh: 使用代理对任何内容进行反向工程，从应用行为到本机二进制文件。

items.description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
items.description_zh: 用于多阶段安全审核的编码代理技能，具有经过独立验证的机器可读结果

items.description: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.
items.description_zh: 编写HTML。渲染视频。专为客服代表打造。

items.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
items.description_zh: 每个座席跨会话的持久上下文 – 捕获座席在会话期间所做的所有操作，使用 AI 对其进行压缩，并将相关上下文注入到未来的会话中。适用于 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex、Gemini、Hermes、Copilot、OpenCode 等

items.description: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.
items.description_zh: 编码代理的设计词汇。更加优雅和大胆地进行引导，通过批评和审计进行审查，在人工智能发布之前抓住它。

items.description: Free, local plugin that keeps tool output out of your coding agent's context window. Sandbox and SQLite FTS5 search, 99% fewer bytes in context. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI and 4 more agents. Zero telemetry.
items.description_zh: 免费的本地插件，可将工具输出保留在编码代理的上下文窗口之外。沙箱和 SQLite FTS5 搜索，上下文字节数减少 99%。可与 Claude Code、Codex、Pi、OpenCode、Gemini CLI、Copilot CLI 和另外 4 个代理配合使用。零遥测。

items.description: Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Pi, OpenCode, Muse, Gemini, and Prime Agent versions of Poteto's pstack. Rigorous agent workflows with Cursor primitives translated for other harnesses.
items.description_zh: Poteto pstack 的 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot、Pi、OpenCode、Muse、Gemini 和 Prime Agent 版本。严格的代理工作流程，并将光标原语转换为其他线束。
